d: Oversee all hotel operations, ensuring high standards of service and guest satisfaction.
Drive revenue growth, profitability, and overall business performance.
Manage P&L, budgets, cost controls, and operational efficiency.
Develop strategies to maximize occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, and GOP.
Lead, develop, and motivate department heads and hotel teams.
Ensure compliance with operational standards, policies, and regulations.
Build strong relationships with key stakeholders and business partners.
Minimum 10–15 years of hospitality experience , including at least 5 years in a General Manager role .
Strong commercial and financial acumen with demonstrated results in revenue growth and profitability.
Excellent leadership, strategic planning, and decision-making skills.
Solid knowledge of hotel operations, revenue management, and guest experience.
GCC or Middle East hospitality experience is preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 15,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.
We’re looking for a Python Engineer who can write high-quality code and build innovative solutions for heavily regulated financial systems.

Whether designing our own chatbot or creating automated financial crime quality controls in just a few weeks, our engineering projects are varied. You’ll collaborate on a product team with Data Scientists, Product Owners, and Operations Managers to deliver the most value to our customers.
Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.
Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.
We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.
